ae2utility.config.allowJeiPatternEncodeW: Allow JEI pattern encode without open terminal

On (default): carrying a wireless encoding terminal in inventory/curios is enough to use JEI pattern encode.
Off: an open pattern-encoding ME menu is required, reducing lag.
ae2utility.config.preferFavoritesForPatt:
On (default): input slots with alternatives prefer ingredients in your JEI bookmarks.
Off: ignore bookmarks and keep the recipe's original alternative order.

message.ae2utility.bulk_encode_exceeds_s: AE2 Utility: batch limit reached (%s patterns); remaining requests in this batch are skipped (see server config).
ae2utility.serverConfig.requireOpenPatte: Require an open pattern-encoding menu for JEI encoding

ae2utility.config.showJeiBatchEncodeFull: Show the full-category JEI batch encode button

On (default): show the button that encodes every recipe in the current JEI category (all pages).
Off: hide it; takes effect after reopening JEI.

jei.tooltip.ae2utility.encode_pattern_ct: Ctrl+left-click: encode the pattern and bookmark inputs that lack an auto-crafting pattern.
Ctrl+Shift+left-click: Shift-upload the pattern (ExtendedAE Plus) and bookmark those inputs as above.
ae2utility.config.reuseProviderWithinBat: Reuse the same provider within a batch upload

On (default): within one JEI batch upload, when a search key matches several providers, pick the provider (by name) chosen earlier in the batch.
Requires ExtendedAE Plus's unique-match auto upload toggle.
Off: choose manually every time.
message.ae2utility.eco_pattern_duplicate: AE2 Utility: this pattern already exists in the ECO crafting system; upload cancelled.
message.ae2utility.batch_encode_precheck: No blank patterns found; batch encoding cancelled.
jei.tooltip.ae2utility.encode_pattern_ho: While hovered, cycling inputs pin to the ingredients that will be encoded.
ae2utility.config.previewEncodeIngredien: Pin encoded ingredients while hovering the encode arrow

On (default): while hovering the JEI encode arrow, input slots with alternatives show the ingredient that will actually be encoded.
Off: keep JEI's alternative cycling.
ae2utility.config.previewEncodeTerminalO: Show an encoding terminal preview on the encode arrow

On (default): the JEI encode arrow tooltip shows a read-only AE2 pattern-encoding terminal layout.
Off: text-only tooltip.
